summary: workflows test-runs list opts out of the live-dogfood error-path probe.
reason: n8n 2.44.4 answers GET /workflows/{unknown}/test-runs with HTTP 200 and an empty list, so a bad workflow id is indistinguishable from a workflow with no test runs. Inventing a not-found rule would misreport real empty results.
validated_outcome: Live dogfood skips error_path for this command with reason no-error-path-probe annotation; help, happy path and JSON checks still run.
